This led to the entire chain of events failing because the fetched code (Quicksort) was likely not the specific code required by the hidden image/script, and even if it were, the initial step of generating the URL was flawed based on the provided instructions. The agent should have verified if the concatenated string was a valid URL before proceeding or realized the premise was broken.
